title: MANET-GNN: Learned Decentralized Optimization of Power Allocation in Multi-Channel MANETs
abstract: arXiv:2609.40170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MANETs enable flexible infrastructure-less wireless connectivity in dynamic and resource-constrained environments. As modern MANETs exploit multiple frequency channels and support heterogeneous traffic patterns, decentralized transmit-power allocation becomes increasingly challenging. We develop a unified learned optimization framework for decentralized power allocation in dynamic multi-hop, multi-channel MANETs. We formulate a constrained end-to-end throughput maximization problem covering unicast, multicast, multicommodity, convergecast, and many-to-many communication. Although centralized and non-convex, this problem serves as an unsupervised training objective for MANET-GNN, a message-passing GNN that operates as a distributed learned optimizer. MANET-GNN uses only local, possibly noisy, CSI and a prescribed number of neighbor message exchanges, enabling low-latency decentralized inference while generalizing across topologies and net

translated_title: MANET-GNN：多信道移动自组网中功率分配的学习式去中心化优化
translated_abstract: 移动自组网（MANET）能够在动态且资源受限的环境中提供灵活的无需基础设施的无线连接。随着现代移动自组网利用多个频率信道并支持异构流量模式，去中心化的发射功率分配变得日益具有挑战性。我们为动态多跳、多信道移动自组网中的去中心化功率分配开发了一个统一的学习式优化框架。我们构建了一个受约束的端到端吞吐量最大化问题，涵盖单播、多播、多商品流、汇聚及多对多通信。尽管该问题是中心化且非凸的，但它可作为MANET-GNN的无监督训练目标。MANET-GNN是一种消息传递图神经网络，作为分布式学习优化器运行，仅使用本地的（可能含噪声的）信道状态信息和规定次数的邻居消息交换，即可实现低延迟的去中心化推理，同时能在不同拓扑和网络间泛化。
tldr: 提出MANET-GNN——一种消息传递图神经网络，以非凸的端到端吞吐量最大化问题作为无监督训练目标，仅利用本地（含噪声）信道状态信息和有限次邻居消息交换，即可实现多信道移动自组网中去中心化功率分配的低延迟分布式优化，并能泛化至不同拓扑。
